interfaces.name: Listing
interfaces.signature: type Listing = { id: string; headline: string; disclaimerText: string; dueMonth: number; dueYear: number; storyText: string; createdAt: string }
interfaces.notes: Single row in practice (no marketplace); modeled as a table so schema/seed script are honest about shape.

interfaces.name: OfferStatus
interfaces.signature: type OfferStatus = 'open' | 'hidden'
interfaces.notes: 'hidden' is the soft-delete state set once reportCount crosses 3; public queries filter it out, row is never deleted.

interfaces.name: Offer
interfaces.signature: type Offer = { id: number; listingId: string; alias: string; storyText: string; amountCents: number; status: OfferStatus; reportCount: number; hiddenAt: string | null; createdAt: string }
interfaces.notes: amountCents is an integer (never float) to keep sort/display exact at the $9,999,999 adversarial value. createdAt is server-assigned, authoritative for the amount-desc/earliest-tiebreak sort. sessionToken deliberately omitted from this client-facing type — see OfferRow.

interfaces.name: OfferRow
interfaces.signature: type OfferRow = Offer & { sessionToken: string }
interfaces.notes: DB-internal only; sessionToken must never be serialized into an API response body.

interfaces.name: CreateOfferInput
interfaces.signature: type CreateOfferInput = { alias: string; storyText: string; amountCents: number }
interfaces.notes: Validated server-side: amountCents in [100, 1000000000] (i.e. $1-$10,000,000), alias <= 60 chars, storyText <= 280 chars; reject non-numeric/negative/zero amount with a specific field-level error, not a generic 400.

interfaces.name: ContentFilterResult
interfaces.signature: type ContentFilterResult = { allowed: boolean; reason?: string }
interfaces.notes: reason must be specific and actionable, never a generic 'rejected'.

interfaces.name: checkContent
interfaces.signature: function checkContent(alias: string, storyText: string): ContentFilterResult
interfaces.notes: Runs server-side as the authoritative check inside POST /api/offers; client may run a mirrored pre-check for snappy UX but must not treat it as sufficient on its own.

interfaces.name: AnonSession
interfaces.signature: type AnonSession = { token: string }
interfaces.notes: Random httpOnly-cookie token issued on first visit (crypto.randomUUID()), not derived from IP/UA, never displayed or exported. Closes the direct-API-abuse gap client-only localStorage mechanisms can't cover.

interfaces.name: RateLimitResult
interfaces.signature: type RateLimitResult = { allowed: boolean; retryAfterSeconds?: number }
interfaces.notes: Soft friction only — never treat as a security control.

interfaces.name: checkRateLimit
interfaces.signature: function checkRateLimit(session[REDACTED:assignment] RateLimitResult
interfaces.notes: Server-side counterpart to the client localStorage rate-limit; both enforce independently but agree in spirit (soft, per-session).

interfaces.name: ReportResult
interfaces.signature: type ReportResult = { accepted: boolean; alreadyReported: boolean; nowHidden: boolean }
interfaces.notes: alreadyReported drives the client's disabled 'Reported' chip; nowHidden true exactly when this report crossed the 3-report threshold.

interfaces.name: GET /api/listing
interfaces.signature: GET /api/listing -> Listing
interfaces.notes: Backs the SSR first paint; also callable client-side for the report-the-listing flow context.

interfaces.name: GET /api/offers
interfaces.signature: GET /api/offers?listingId=string -> { offers: Offer[] }
interfaces.notes: Returns only status='open' rows, already sorted amount-desc/createdAt-asc by the server; client never re-sorts. Polled client-side every ~20s (paused on Page Visibility hidden) to drive ambient reorder animation from other visitors' submissions.

interfaces.name: POST /api/offers
interfaces.signature: POST /api/offers { body: CreateOfferInput } -> { offer: Offer } | { error: { field: string; reason: string } }
interfaces.notes: Runs checkContent then checkRateLimit server-side before insert; on DB write failure returns a distinct 5xx the client maps to the failure/retry state, never a partial success.

interfaces.name: POST /api/offers/[offerId]/report
interfaces.signature: POST /api/offers/{offerId}/report -> ReportResult
interfaces.notes: Enforces one-report-per-session server-side via AnonSession token in addition to the client's localStorage cap.

interfaces.name: POST /api/listing/report
interfaces.signature: POST /api/listing/{listingId}/report -> ReportResult
interfaces.notes: Same mechanism as offer reports, applied to the listing itself per R-015.

interfaces.name: SubmissionState
interfaces.signature: type SubmissionState = 'idle' | 'validating' | 'filterChecking' | 'filterRejected' | 'ready' | 'disclaimerAck' | 'checkoutProcessing' | 'success' | 'failure'
interfaces.notes: Exact state machine from design_handoff; 'success' is only reachable after the POST /api/offers response resolves, never optimistically.

interfaces.name: useOfferSubmission
interfaces.signature: function useOfferSubmission(listingId: string): { state: SubmissionState; error: { field: string; reason: string } | null; submittedOffer: Offer | null; dispatch: (event: SubmissionEvent) => void }
interfaces.notes: Owns the OfferFormSheet + CheckoutSheet state machine end to end; the only place allowed to transition to 'success'.

interfaces.name: SubmissionEvent
interfaces.signature: type SubmissionEvent = { type: 'FIELD_CHANGE' | 'SUBMIT_FORM' | 'ACK_DISCLAIMER' | 'CONFIRM_PAY' | 'RETRY' | 'DISMISS' }
interfaces.notes: Input events driving useOfferSubmission's transitions.

interfaces.name: OfferCardViewModel
interfaces.signature: type OfferCardViewModel = { offer: Offer; rank: number; isOwnSubmission: boolean }
interfaces.notes: isOwnSubmission drives the glow/pulse styling on the visitor's own card after their submission or after a poll refresh.

interfaces.name: computeFlipDiff
interfaces.signature: function computeFlipDiff(prevOrder: OfferCardViewModel[], nextOrder: OfferCardViewModel[]): { id: number; deltaX: number; deltaY: number }[]
interfaces.notes: Pure position-diff function; the WAAPI animation layer consumes this. Reused identically for self-submission and ambient poll-driven reorders.

interfaces.name: announceRankChange
interfaces.signature: function announceRankChange(rank: number, amountCents: number): string
interfaces.notes: Produces the aria-live announcement text; must fire on every reorder regardless of prefers-reduced-motion.

interfaces.name: prefersReducedMotion
interfaces.signature: function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean
interfaces.notes: Gates whether computeFlipDiff's output is animated via WAAPI tween or applied as an instant opacity/highlight flash.

interfaces.name: POST /api/listing/[listingId]/report
interfaces.signature: POST /api/listing/{listingId}/report -> ReportResult
interfaces.notes: Same mechanism as offer reports, applied to the listing itself.

interfaces.name: useOfferPolling
interfaces.signature: function useOfferPolling(listingId: string, intervalMs?: number): { offers: Offer[] }
interfaces.notes: Polls GET /api/offers every ~20s, paused via Page Visibility API when backgrounded; feeds the same computeFlipDiff/animation path as self-submission reorders. Should-have, must never take build priority over safety-load-bearing states.
